sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for Dealbook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》每日简报

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: Dealbook栏目的商业与政策记者。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市的Dealbook峰会上，与商业、政治和文化领域一些举足轻重的领袖进行现场对谈，其中包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经滤镜的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上直播精选对谈，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: November 18th.
If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用来观看，并免费获得一个月的所有新闻内容访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你会收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: The confirmation hearing of Gina Haspel as President Trump's CIA director, focused on an unusual line of questioning.
sentences.zh: 吉娜·哈斯佩尔作为特朗普总统的CIA局长提名人的确认听证会，聚焦于一个不同寻常的提问方向。

sentences.en: What is your moral character?
sentences.zh: 你的道德品质是什么？

sentences.en: It's Thursday, May 10th.
sentences.zh: 今天是5月10日，星期四。

sentences.en: Matt Rosenberg, what is the situation that Gina Haspel is walking into on Wednesday morning on Capitol Hill?
sentences.zh: 马特·罗森伯格，周三清晨吉娜·哈斯佩尔在国会山面对的是什么局面？

sentences.en: So Gina Haspel is not a name that is known to most Americans because she spent 33 years as a clandestine officer in the CIA.
sentences.zh: 所以吉娜·哈斯佩尔并不是一个大多数美国人熟悉的名字，因为她作为CIA的秘密特工度过了33年。

sentences.en: Almost her entire life was classified until very recently.
sentences.zh: 直到最近，她几乎一生的经历都处于保密状态。

sentences.en: She played a significant role in what was known as the rendition, detention, and interrogation program
sentences.zh: 她在布什政府时期被称为引渡、拘留与审讯计划的

sentences.en: under the Bush administration, the torture program, the program under which suspects were waterboarded.
sentences.zh: 项目中扮演了重要角色，也就是酷刑计划，即对嫌疑人实施水刑的计划。

sentences.en: They were kept in secret prisons at black sites.
sentences.zh: 他们被关押在黑点的秘密监狱里。

sentences.en: So in 2002, she briefly oversaw one of these black sites in Thailand.
sentences.zh: 所以在2002年，她曾在泰国短暂监管过其中一个黑点。

sentences.en: And a Al-Qaeda suspect was waterboarded three times while she was there.
sentences.zh: 在她任职期间，一名基地组织嫌疑人被实施了三次水刑。

sentences.en: A few years later, she was a senior official back at CIA headquarters in Langley.
sentences.zh: 几年后，她回到兰利的CIA总部担任高级官员。

sentences.en: And an order to destroy videos documenting brutal interrogations and torture at that black site in Thailand was conveyed under her name.
sentences.zh: 一份销毁泰国那个黑点中记录残酷审讯和酷刑的录像带的命令，是以她的名义传达的。

sentences.en: Now, the order was made by her boss at the time, but there's always been a lot of questions.
sentences.zh: 现在，这个命令是由她当时的直属上司下达的，但一直以来都有很多疑问。

sentences.en: What was her role in this?
sentences.zh: 她在其中扮演了什么角色？

sentences.en: Was she pushing for the destruction?
sentences.zh: 她是在力推销毁吗？

sentences.en: The White House didn't want it destroyed.
sentences.zh: 白宫并不想销毁它们。

sentences.en: There were a lot of other parts of the government saying, do not destroy this.
sentences.zh: 政府中还有很多其他部门说，千万不要销毁。

sentences.en: So those are the big things that the Democrats especially are looking to pressure on.
sentences.zh: 所以这些是民主党人格外想要施压的重大问题。

sentences.en: And I think for most Americans, this is an issue that's in the past, but her nomination has kind of brought it back out into the forefront.
sentences.zh: 我想对大多数美国人来说，这是一个已经成为过去的问题，但她的提名某种程度上把它重新拉回了大众视野。

sentences.en: And going to Wednesday's hearing, we were going to get another airing of the unanswered questions about this program and this chapter in both the CIA's history and
sentences.zh: 在周三的听证会上，我们将再次听到关于这个计划以及CIA历史和美国历史中这一篇章的未解之谜的讨论

sentences.en: American history, where we basically tortured suspected Al-Qaeda members.
sentences.zh: ，当时我们基本上对疑似基地组织成员施用了酷刑。

sentences.en: A kind of moral reckoning.
sentences.zh: 一种道德清算。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I'd like to call this hearing to order.
sentences.zh: 我宣布此次听证会开始。

sentences.en: So what actually happens when this hearing starts?
sentences.zh: 那么听证会开始时究竟发生了什么？

sentences.en: I'd like to welcome our witness, acting director of the Central Intelligence Agency,
sentences.zh: 我想欢迎我们的证人，中央情报局代理局长

sentences.en: Ms. Gina Haspel.
sentences.zh: 吉娜·哈斯佩尔女士。

sentences.en: So Senator Richard Burr, the North Carolina Republican who is the chairman, he opens it with, I mean, what can only be described as a very adoring statement.
sentences.zh: 北卡罗来纳州共和党人、主席理查德·伯尔的开场白，可以说是非常赞赏有加。

sentences.en: Gina, congratulations on your nomination.
sentences.zh: 吉娜，祝贺你获得提名。

sentences.en: Our goal in conducting this hearing is to enable the committee to begin consideration of Ms. Haspel's qualifications and to allow for thoughtful deliberation by all members.
sentences.zh: 我们举行这次听证会的目的是让委员会开始审议哈斯佩尔女士的资格，并允许所有成员进行深思熟虑的讨论。

sentences.en: He calls for the most qualified nominee he's ever seen in his 24 years in Congress.
sentences.zh: 他称赞她是自己进入国会24年来见过的最合格的提名人。

sentences.en: You are without a doubt the most qualified person the president could have chosen to lead the CIA and the most prepared nominee in its 70-year history.
sentences.zh: 毫无疑问，你是总统为领导中情局所能选择的最具资格的人，也是其70年历史上准备最充分的提名人。

sentences.en: He kind of sends a shot across the bow of the Democrats saying this hearing is about the next CIA director, not about a program that's in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 他某种程度上向民主党人发出了警告，称这次听证会是关于下一任中情局局长的，而不是关于已经成为过去的计划的。

sentences.en: This hearing's not about programs already addressed by executive order, legislation, and the court of law.
sentences.zh: 这次听证会不是关于行政命令、立法和法庭已经处理过的计划。

sentences.en: It's about the woman seated in front of us.
sentences.zh: 它是关于坐在我们面前这位女性的。

sentences.en: You should be asking past presidents, past attorney generals, past CIA directors about that.
sentences.zh: 你们应该去问前总统、前总检察长、前中情局局长关于那些事情。

sentences.en: She's not the one to ask about that.
sentences.zh: 她不是回答这些问题的人。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Ms. Haspel, what the committee must hear and what I must hear is, in your own view, given the benefit of time and hindsight, should the United States ever permit detainees to be
sentences.zh: 哈斯佩尔女士，委员会必须听到、我也必须听到的是，在你看来，结合时间和事后诸葛亮的视角，美国是否应该允许对被扣押人员的对待

sentences.en: treated the way the CIA treated detainees under the program?
sentences.zh: 像中情局在该计划下对待被扣押人员那样？

sentences.en: Then you get Mark Warner, the top Democrat on the committee.
sentences.zh: 然后轮到委员会中级别最高的民主党人马克·沃纳。

sentences.en: He takes the other view.
sentences.zh: 他持相反的观点。

sentences.en: What I'm not willing to do, however, is to justify this dark period in our history or to sweep away the decision to engage in torture.
sentences.zh: 然而，我绝对不会做的是，为我们历史上的这段黑暗时期辩护，或者抹杀参与酷刑的决定。

sentences.en: Now, look, the techniques used in the program, waterboarding, stress positions, sleep deprivation, that's all been outlawed.
sentences.zh: 看吧，该计划中使用的技术，水刑、压力姿势、剥夺睡眠，这些都已经遭到取缔。

sentences.en: So Haspel won't be able to decide on her own if they want to go back to that.
sentences.zh: 所以哈斯佩尔无法独自决定是否要恢复那种做法。

sentences.en: But there is the specter of the president who's made it very clear that he thinks this works.
sentences.zh: 但这里存在着总统的阴影，他非常明确地表示他认为这行之有效。

sentences.en: He wants to see it brought back.
sentences.zh: 他希望看到它卷土重来。

sentences.en: Ms. Haspel, I encourage you to take these issues seriously.
sentences.zh: 哈斯佩尔女士，我鼓励你认真对待这些问题。

sentences.en: And to address them at length.
sentences.zh: 并进行详细的阐述。

sentences.en: My vote on your confirmation will be greatly influenced by how you address these questions today.
sentences.zh: 我对我是否投票确认你的提名，将在很大程度上取决于你今天如何回答这些问题。

sentences.en: So then it's Haspel's turn.
sentences.zh: 接下来轮到哈斯佩尔了。

sentences.en: Chairman Burr, Vice Chairman Warner, and members of the committee.
sentences.zh: 伯尔主席、沃纳副主席以及委员会的各位成员。

sentences.en: You know, this is somebody who's never before really spoken in public.
sentences.zh: 要知道，这是一个从未真正在公众面前讲过话的人。

sentences.en: I mean, this is somebody who really did live a life in the shadows.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一个真正生活在阴影中度过一生的人。

sentences.en: I welcome the opportunity to introduce myself to the American people for the first time.
sentences.zh: 我欢迎有机会第一次向美国人民介绍我自己。

sentences.en: It is a new experience for me as I spent over 30 years undercover and in the shadows.
sentences.zh: 对我来说这是一次新奇的体验，因为我曾在秘密战线和阴影中度过了30多年。

sentences.en: I don't have any social media accounts.
sentences.zh: 我没有任何社交媒体账号。

sentences.en: But otherwise, I think you will find me to be a typical middle class American.
sentences.zh: 但除此之外，我想你们会发现我是一个典型中产阶级美国人。

sentences.en: One with a strong sense of right and wrong and one who loves this country.
sentences.zh: 一个有着强烈的对错观、一个热爱这个国家的人。

sentences.en: And she tries to kind of portray herself as this kind of Air Force brat from Kentucky who became a spy.
sentences.zh: 她试图将自己塑造成来自肯塔基州的、后来成为间谍的空军军人子弟形象。

sentences.en: I joined CIA in 1985 as a case officer in the clandestine service.
sentences.zh: 我在1985年加入中情局，在秘密行动处担任案件官员。

sentences.en: I think this is important because going into this, when she was first nominated in March, we didn't even know where she was from.
sentences.zh: 我认为这很重要，因为在刚开始时，当她在3月份首次被提名时，我们甚至不知道她来自哪里。

sentences.en: Literally, like town state.
sentences.zh: 字面意思，比如哪个镇哪个州。

sentences.en: Town state.
sentences.zh: 哪个镇哪个州。

sentences.en: Didn't know where she went to high school.
sentences.zh: 不知道她上的是哪所高中。

sentences.en: Didn't know where she went to college.
sentences.zh: 不知道她上的是哪所大学。

sentences.en: All that stuff was classified.
sentences.zh: 所有这些信息都是保密的。

sentences.en: So her kind of repeating this stuff is getting more of it out there and acknowledging that, like, nobody knows who I am.
sentences.zh: 所以她这样重复这些事情，可以让更多人了解，并承认，诸如，没有人知道我是谁。

sentences.en: I recall very well my first meeting with a foreign agent.
sentences.zh: 我非常清楚地记得我与外国特工的第一次会面。

sentences.en: She tries to kind of hit the romance of it.
sentences.zh: 她试图渲染其中的浪漫色彩。

sentences.en: It was on a dark, moonless night with an agent I'd never met before.
sentences.zh: 那是一个黑暗、没有月亮的夜晚，和一个我从未见过的特工在一起。

sentences.en: When I picked him up, he passed me the intelligence and I passed him an extra $500 for the men he led.
sentences.zh: 当我接上他时，他把情报递给我，我塞给他手下的人额外的500美元。

sentences.en: It was the beginning of an adventure I had only dreamed of.
sentences.zh: 那是一场我梦寐以求的冒险的开始。

sentences.en: She says something about how I excelled in finding and acquiring secret information that I obtained in brush passes, dead drops, or meetings in dusty alleys.
sentences.zh: 她提到了一些事情，比如我在寻找和获取秘密信息方面表现出色，那些通过无接触传递、死信箱或在尘土飞扬的小巷里会面获得的信息。

sentences.en: What's a brush pass?
sentences.zh: 什么是无接触传递？

sentences.en: Literally brushing past somebody and they hand off information.
sentences.zh: 字面意思就是从某人身边擦肩而过，然后他们递过情报。

sentences.en: And so, like, you know, you can see there's like this nod to the kind of...
sentences.zh: 所以，你看，你可以看到这里有一种对……的致敬

sentences.en: The cinematic version of this job.
sentences.zh: 这项工作的电影版本。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 对，没错。

sentences.en: But then she gets to the one question that everybody's kind of got.
sentences.zh: 但随后她谈到了每个人都在关注的那个问题。

sentences.en: In light of my counterterrorism experience, I understand that what many people want to know about are my views on CIA's former detention and interrogation program.
sentences.zh: 鉴于我的反恐经验，我理解许多人想了解的是我对中情局前拘留与审讯计划的看法。

sentences.en: I have views on this issue and I want to be clear.
sentences.zh: 我对这个问题有看法，我想说清楚。

sentences.en: And she dresses it, I think, in a way the CIA thinks is directly.
sentences.zh: 我认为她以中情局认为直接的方式对此进行了包装。

sentences.en: Having served in that tumultuous time, I can offer you my personal commitment, clearly and without reservation, that under my leadership, on my watch,
sentences.zh: 由于曾在那段动荡时期服役，我可以向你们做出个人的承诺，明确且毫无保留地表示，在我的领导下、在我的任期内

sentences.en: CIA will not restart a detention and interrogation program.
sentences.zh: ，中情局不会重启拘留与审讯计划。

sentences.en: It was clear that that was not going to satisfy Democrats on the committee.
sentences.zh: 很显然，这并不能令委员会中的民主党人满意。

sentences.en: It was way too vague and they wanted a lot more.
sentences.zh: 这实在是太含糊了，他们想要更多。

sentences.en: And they wanted to talk morals and right and wrong.
sentences.zh: 他们想谈论道德以及对与错。

sentences.en: She wanted to talk legal and illegal.
sentences.zh: 她则想谈论合法与非法。

sentences.en: Question I have.
sentences.zh: 我有一个问题。

sentences.en: With the benefit of hindsight, do you believe the program, in terms of the interrogation program, was consistent with American values?
sentences.zh: 事后看来，你认为这个计划，就审讯计划而言，是否符合美国的价值观？

sentences.en: So it felt like a lot of the questions were focused on these two incidents that are at the center of her reputation.
sentences.zh: 所以感觉许多问题都集中在她声誉核心的这两起事件上。

sentences.en: The interrogations that happened under her watch and the tape destruction.
sentences.zh: 在她监管下发生的审讯以及销毁录像带事件。

sentences.en: Let's start with the interrogations.
sentences.zh: 让我们从审讯开始。

sentences.en: What did senators want to know about that chapter of her career?
sentences.zh: 参议员们想了解她职业生涯的那一章什么？

sentences.en: Have your views of the program evolved in the years following the attacks on our country on 9-11?
sentences.zh: 在我国遭遇9-11袭击之后的几年里，你对该计划的看法是否发生了演变？

sentences.en: I mean, I'm not sure they wanted some details on this as to know if she regretted it or if she thought it was wrong.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我不确定他们是想要这方面的某些细节，还是想知道她是否对此感到后悔，或者她是否认为这是错误的。

sentences.en: And she just wasn't giving up ground on that.
sentences.zh: 而她在这个问题上就是不肯让步。

sentences.en: Senator, they have.
sentences.zh: 参议员，它们确实演变了。

sentences.en: I think it's very important.
sentences.zh: 我认为这非常重要。

sentences.en: I think for any leader, as you go through a career, you have to learn the leadership lessons.
sentences.zh: 我认为对任何领导者来说，随着职业生涯的发展，你必须吸取领导力教训。

sentences.en: I'm not going to sit here with the benefit of hindsight and judge the very good people who made hard decisions,
sentences.zh: 我不会坐在这里，借着事后诸葛亮的视角去评判那些做出艰难决定的优秀人们

sentences.en: who were running the agency in very extraordinary circumstances at the time.
sentences.zh: ，他们在当时非常非同寻常的环境下管理着机构。

sentences.en: You know, we were doing the best we could, making it up as we went along is kind of the general theme here.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这里的大致基调是我们已经尽力做到最好，走一步算一步。

sentences.en: And she later even says, she says, you know, they did extraordinary work.
sentences.zh: 她后来甚至说，她知道，他们做了非凡的工作。

sentences.en: I'm very proud of the fact that we captured the perpetrator of 9-11, Khalid Sheikh Mohammed.
sentences.zh: 我为我们抓获9-11事件的元凶哈立德·谢赫·穆罕默德这一事实感到非常自豪。

sentences.en: I think we did extraordinary work.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们做了非凡的工作。

sentences.en: She kind of very defiantly says after 9-11...
sentences.zh: 她在9-11事件后表现得十分挑衅……

sentences.en: I didn't look to go sit on the Swiss desk.
sentences.zh: 我没有去争取坐在瑞士办公桌前。

sentences.en: I stepped up.
sentences.zh: 我挺身而出。

sentences.en: I was not on the sidelines.
sentences.zh: 我没有袖手旁观。

sentences.en: I was on the front lines in the Cold War, and I was on the front lines in the fight against Al-Qaeda.
sentences.zh: 我站在冷战的前线，我也站在打击基地组织斗争的前线。

sentences.en: And then she says, to me, the tragedy...
sentences.zh: 然后她说，对我而言，悲剧在于……

sentences.en: ...is that the controversy surrounding the interrogation program has cast a shadow over what has been a major contribution to protecting this country.
sentences.zh: ……围绕审讯计划的争议，给那些为保护这个国家做出重大贡献的事业蒙上了阴影。

sentences.en: And when she says the Swiss desk, I assume she means kind of a comfy desk job in Europe where there's no conflict.
sentences.zh: 当她提到瑞士办公桌时，我猜她指的是欧洲那些没有冲突的舒适的办公室工作。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Senator, I think like all of us who were in the counterterrorism center and working at CIA in those years after 9-11, we all believed in our work.
sentences.zh: 参议员，我认为就像所有在反恐中心以及在9-11之后那些年里在中情局工作的人一样，我们都坚信我们的工作。

sentences.en: So what's her essential argument about the interrogation techniques that were used post-9-11?
sentences.zh: 那么她对9-11之后使用的审讯技术的基本论点是什么？

sentences.en: That they were legal.
sentences.zh: 它们是合法的。

sentences.en: And we had been informed that the techniques in CIA's program were legal and authorized by the highest legal authority in our country and also the president.
sentences.zh: 我们曾被告知，中情局计划中的技术是合法的，并得到了我国最高法律权威以及总统的授权。

sentences.en: And that's kind of the CIA argument of this, is that, like, look, these people were faithfully carrying out orders that were declared legal by the government.
sentences.zh: 这可以说是中情局对此的论点，那就是，看吧，这些人是在忠实地执行被政府宣布为合法的命令。

sentences.en: But CIA does not today conduct interrogations.
sentences.zh: 但中情局如今并不进行审讯。

sentences.en: We never did historically, and we're not getting back in that business.
sentences.zh: 历史上从来没有，我们也不会重操旧业。

sentences.en: But we don't want to do it again.
sentences.zh: 但我们不想再这样做了。

sentences.en: We don't want to be interrogating people.
sentences.zh: 我们不想再审讯人了。

sentences.en: That's up to the military, the FBI, whomever.
sentences.zh: 那是军方、联邦调查局或其他什么人的事。

sentences.en: The president has asserted that torture works.
sentences.zh: 总统曾断言酷刑管用。

sentences.en: Do you agree with that statement?
sentences.zh: 你同意这种说法吗？

sentences.en: So she had an exchange with Kamala Harris, who is a California Democrat.
sentences.zh: 因此她与来自加利福尼亚州的民主党人卡玛拉·哈里斯进行了一番交锋。

sentences.en: I walked away from the exchange thinking, hmm, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我离开交锋现场时心想，嗯，我不知道。

sentences.en: I actually don't know what she thinks here.
sentences.zh: 我实际上不知道她在这里是怎么想的。

sentences.en: Senator, I don't believe that torture works.
sentences.zh: 参议员，我不认为酷刑管用。

sentences.en: She does not believe that it works.
sentences.zh: 她不认为这管用。

sentences.en: But she then adds.
sentences.zh: 但她随后补充道。

sentences.en: I believe that in the CIA's program, and I'm not attributing this to enhanced interrogation techniques.
sentences.zh: 我相信在中情局的计划中，我并不是将此归因于强化审讯技术。

sentences.en: I believe, as many people, directors who have sat in this chair before me,
sentences.zh: 我相信，就像许多人、以及曾坐在这个位置上的前任局长们所认为的那样，

sentences.en: that valuable information was obtained from senior al-Qaeda operatives that allowed us to defend this country and prevent another attack.
sentences.zh: 我们从基地组织高级特工那里获得了宝贵的情报，这让我们得以保卫这个国家并防止了另一次袭击。

sentences.en: Is that a yes?
sentences.zh: 这是在说是吗？

sentences.en: No, it's not a yes.
sentences.zh: 不，这不是在说是。

sentences.en: We got valuable information from debriefing of al-Qaeda detainees.
sentences.zh: 我们从对基地组织被关押人员的盘问中获得了宝贵的情报。

sentences.en: And I don't think it's knowable whether interrogation techniques played a role in that.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，审讯技术在其中是否起到了作用是无从得知的。

sentences.en: So I'm like, well, what does she believe here?
sentences.zh: 所以我在想，她到底是怎么想的呢？

sentences.en: I mean, that's, look, that's the other problem here.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，听着，这就是另一个问题所在。

sentences.en: She has a lifelong, we're talking like a real spy.
sentences.zh: 她有着一生的资历，我们说的是一个真正的间谍。

sentences.en: And part of being good at that is being somewhat invisible, somewhat forgettable, and hard to pin down, and not really committing oneself to one thing or the other.
sentences.zh: 而要擅长这一点，部分原因在于要做到有点隐形、有点容易被人遗忘、难以捉摸，并且不真正把自己束缚于某一种特定的立场。

sentences.en: And I think you saw some of that on display.
sentences.zh: 我想你从她身上看到了一些这样的表现。

sentences.en: She could be very feisty, very confrontational, but also pretty evasive and kind of smooth about it, too.
sentences.zh: 她可以非常强硬、充满对抗性，但同时也相当闪烁其词，而且处理得很圆滑。

sentences.en: Let's move on to the videotapes.
sentences.zh: 让我们转向录像带的话题。

sentences.en: And what about the tapes?
sentences.zh: 那录像带是怎么回事？

sentences.en: What did senators want to know about the destruction of these tapes, which captured some of these interrogation techniques that Haspel now says she thinks should be banned?
sentences.zh: 参议员们想了解关于销毁这些录像带的什么情况？这些录像带记录了哈斯佩尔现在认为应该被禁止的一些审讯技术。

sentences.en: So I think they wanted to know, what exactly was her role here?
sentences.zh: 所以我想他们是想知道，她在这里面究竟扮演了什么角色？

sentences.en: Was she pushing for this?
sentences.zh: 她是在极力推动这件事吗？

sentences.en: Was she a proponent of destroying them?
sentences.zh: 她是销毁录像带的支持者吗？

sentences.en: You told me earlier this week that you supported the decision of the CIA's deputy director of operations to order the destruction of those videotapes.
sentences.zh: 你本周早些时候告诉我，你支持中情局副行动局长下令销毁那些录像带的决定。

sentences.en: Would you still support that order today?
sentences.zh: 今天你还会支持那个命令吗？

sentences.en: Senator, I would not.
sentences.zh: 参议员，我不会了。

sentences.en: I think it's, as I said, it's very important that people learn.
sentences.zh: 我认为，正如我所说，人们吸取教训是非常重要的。

sentences.en: Experience is a good teacher.
sentences.zh: 经验是最好的老师。

sentences.en: And the piece that was missing from the tapes was making sure that we had all the stakeholders' concurrence.
sentences.zh: 而录像带事件中所缺失的一环，是确保我们获得了所有利益相关方的同意。

sentences.en: She wouldn't get into it.
sentences.zh: 她不愿深入谈论此事。

sentences.en: She would say that, like, there were agency personnel whose faces were on the tapes, and that was security risk.
sentences.zh: 她会说，比如，录像带里有中情局人员的面孔，那是一个安全风险。

sentences.en: And there were a lot of leaks coming out of the CIA about that time.
sentences.zh: 而且当时中情局流出了很多泄密消息。

sentences.en: And so to protect people, they had to do this.
sentences.zh: 因此为了保护人员，他们不得不这么做。

sentences.en: Destroy the tapes.
sentences.zh: 销毁录像带。

sentences.en: Destroy the tapes.
sentences.zh: 销毁录像带。

sentences.en: But she also seemed to acknowledge that a lot of, like, you know, the White House counsel's office and others had told them not to.
sentences.zh: 但她似乎也承认，诸如白宫法律顾问办公室和其他许多人曾告诉他们不要这么做。

sentences.en: And that this may not have been an entirely right decision.
sentences.zh: 而且这可能并不是一个完全正确的决定。

sentences.en: So one question I've not heard you answer is, do you believe that the previous interrogation techniques were immoral?
sentences.zh: 所以有一个我没听你回答过的问题是，你认为先前的审讯技术是不道德的吗？

sentences.en: So the question, Matt, that I kept hearing over and over again, and it doesn't feel like this is a topic that comes up a lot in Senate confirmation hearings, is essentially,
sentences.zh: 所以，马特，我不断听到、而且感觉在参议员提名听证会上并不经常出现的一个问题，本质上是：

sentences.en: what is your moral code, Gina Haspel?
sentences.zh: 吉娜·哈斯佩尔，你的道德准则是什么？

sentences.en: Most importantly, in your view, was that program consistent with American values?
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，在你看来，那个项目符合美国的价值观吗？

sentences.en: You're right.
sentences.zh: 你说得对。

sentences.en: It doesn't really come up because, I mean, how many government officials are confronted with that really stark question of morality?
sentences.zh: 这个问题确实不常出现，因为，我的意思是，有多少政府官员会面对那种如此严苛的道德拷问？

sentences.en: Am I going to, like, maybe torture somebody?
sentences.zh: 我是不是要去折磨某个人？

sentences.en: That's not a question that a lot of people in our government ever have to wrestle with.
sentences.zh: 这不是我们政府中的大多数人需要去纠结的问题。

sentences.en: And Haspel oversaw interrogations that are, by almost any standard, considered torture.
sentences.zh: 而哈斯佩尔监督的审讯，按几乎任何标准来看都被认为是酷刑。

sentences.en: And she's going to be working for a president who has made it very clear he wants to torture people.
sentences.zh: 并且她将为一位已经明确表示他想要折磨人的总统工作。

sentences.en: We must hear how you would react if the president asked you to carry out some morally questionable behavior.
sentences.zh: 我们必须听听，如果总统要求你实施某些在道德上有疑问的行为，你会作何反应。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So senators might be especially concerned with whether or not she's willing to exercise her own moral agency in the face of a commander-in-chief who says,
sentences.zh: 所以参议员们可能会特别关心，面对一位三军统帅说出这样的话时，她是否愿意行使自己独立的道德代理权——

sentences.en: do something that you have said you will not do, but I'm telling you now, you need to do it, especially something like waterboarding or torture.
sentences.zh: 去做一件你已经说过你不会做的事，但我现在告诉你，你必须去做，尤其是像水刑或酷刑这样的事。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And we've seen the president has a lot of power to kind of declare things legal.
sentences.zh: 我们已经看到总统拥有很大的权力来宣布某些事情合法。

sentences.en: It may be gray, it may be ambiguous, but you can create the justification if you need it.
sentences.zh: 这可能是灰色地带，可能是模棱两可的，但如果你需要的话，你可以制造出合法的理由。

sentences.en: And is she going to say no?
sentences.zh: 而她会说不吗？

sentences.en: Ms. Haspel, my question is this.
sentences.zh: 哈斯佩尔女士，我的问题是这样的。

sentences.en: On a going-forward basis, if this president asks you to do something that you find morally objectionable, what will you do?
sentences.zh: 展望未来，如果这位总统要求你做一件你觉得在道德上无法接受的事情，你会怎么做？

sentences.en: Will you carry that out or not?
sentences.zh: 你会执行它还是不会？

sentences.en: I mean, we're entrusting you in a very different position if you're confirmed.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果你得到确认，我们是在把一个非常不同的职位托付给你。

sentences.en: I just need to know what your response that would be.
sentences.zh: 我只是需要知道你的回应会是什么。

sentences.en: Senator, my moral compass is strong.
sentences.zh: 参议员，我的道德指南针很坚定。

sentences.en: I would not allow CIA to undertake activity that I thought was immoral, even if it was technically legal.
sentences.zh: 我不会允许中情局开展我认为是不道德的活动，即使它在技术上是合法的。

sentences.en: I would absolutely not permit it.
sentences.zh: 我绝对不会允许。

sentences.en: So you would not follow the order if you felt it was?
sentences.zh: 所以如果你觉得它是的话，你不会服从命令？

sentences.en: No.
sentences.zh: 不会。

sentences.en: I believe that CIA must undertake activities that are consistent with American values.
sentences.zh: 我相信中情局必须开展符合美国价值观的活动。

sentences.en: America is looked at all over the world as an example to everyone else in the world.
sentences.zh: 世界各地都把美国视为世界上其他所有人的榜样。

sentences.en: And we have to uphold that.
sentences.zh: 我们必须维护这一点。

sentences.en: And CIA is included in that.
sentences.zh: 中情局也包含在其中。

sentences.en: She at one point did say yes.
sentences.zh: 她一度确实说过会。

sentences.en: If there's something truly immoral, I will say no to him.
sentences.zh: 如果有真正不道德的事情，我会对他说不。

sentences.en: Say no to the commander-in-chief.
sentences.zh: 对三军统帅说不。

sentences.en: Say no to the president.
sentences.zh: 对总统说不。

sentences.en: Yes, say no to the commander-in-chief.
sentences.zh: 是的，对三军统帅说不。

sentences.en: But I think the senators are also very aware that that answer is going to be given in private.
sentences.zh: 但我认为参议员们也非常清楚，那个回答会是在私下里给出的。

sentences.en: And that we may never hear about it.
sentences.zh: 而且我们可能永远也不会听到有关它的消息。

sentences.en: And they asked, are we going to be told if that's the case?
sentences.zh: 他们质问：如果是这样的话，我们会不会得到通知？

sentences.en: And if you were approached in such a way and such a demand was made of you, would you inform this committee and the Congress that you had been so approached?
sentences.zh: 如果你被以这种方式接近并被提出了这样的要求，你会将你曾受到这种接近告知本委员会和国会吗？

sentences.en: Senator, I've worked very closely with this president.
sentences.zh: 参议员，我与这位总统共事非常密切。

sentences.en: I don't believe that such a circumstance would ever occur.
sentences.zh: 我不认为会出现这样的一种情况。

sentences.en: CIA has been treated with enormous respect.
sentences.zh: 中情局受到了极大的尊重。

sentences.en: And our expertise is valued for what we bring to the table.
sentences.zh: 我们带到桌面上的专业知识受到了重视。

sentences.en: If it occurred, would you inform the committee?
sentences.zh: 如果发生了，你会通知委员会吗？

sentences.en: Senator, it's a hypothetical.
sentences.zh: 参议员，这是一个假设性问题。

sentences.en: I don't think it's going to occur.
sentences.zh: 我认为它不会发生。

sentences.en: I'm very confident about that.
sentences.zh: 对此我非常有信心。

sentences.en: It does not seem to be a hypothetical.
sentences.zh: 这看起来不像是一个假设。

sentences.en: People have alleged that that has happened already.
sentences.zh: 人们已经指控这种情况已经发生过了。

sentences.en: Senator, I don't know anything about that conversation.
sentences.zh: 参议员，我对那场对话一无所知。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: It's kind of interesting.
sentences.zh: 这挺有意思的。

sentences.en: It reminds me a bit of James Comey as head of the FBI, rejecting the president's request that he act out of loyalty to him, this famous dinner at the White House,
sentences.zh: 这让我有点想起担任FBI局长的詹姆斯·科米，他拒绝了总统关于对效忠于他的要求——白宫的这场著名晚宴——

sentences.en: at the expense of his own kind of moral judgments.
sentences.zh: 以牺牲他自己的某种道德判断为代价。

sentences.en: And we all know what Comey did now because of the memos and the reporting in the Times.
sentences.zh: 我们现在都知道科米因为备忘录和《纽约时报》的报道做了什么。

sentences.en: But basically, Haspel's being asked, would you do what Comey did?
sentences.zh: 但基本上，别人在问哈斯佩尔：你会做科米做过的事吗？

sentences.en: Would you tell the commander-in-chief no?
sentences.zh: 你会对三军统帅说不吗？

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: There have been allegations, Mr. Comey, one, that while he was alone, the president asked for a personal pledge of loyalty.
sentences.zh: 有指控称，科米先生，第一，当他独自一人时，总统索要了个人的效忠承诺。

sentences.en: If you were ever approached by the president and asked for a personal pledge of loyalty, what would you respond?
sentences.zh: 如果总统曾经接近你并索要个人的效忠承诺，你会如何回应？

sentences.en: Senator, my only loyalty is to the American people and the Constitution of the United States.
sentences.zh: 参议员，我唯一的效忠对象是美国人民和美利坚合众国宪法。

sentences.en: I am honored bound and will work very hard to deliver to this president and his administration the best performance and intelligence CIA can deliver.
sentences.zh: 我有幸承担这一职责，并将非常努力地为这位总统及其政府提供中情局所能提供的最佳表现和情报。

sentences.en: And, you know, there is, at the CIA especially, this culture of keeping things secret.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，尤其是在中情局，存在着一种保守秘密的文化。

sentences.en: This is an agency—I'm not sure everyone fully understands how much kind of transparency there is in our government.
sentences.zh: 这是一个机构——我不确定每个人是否都完全理解我们的政府有多少透明度。

sentences.en: And even at the Pentagon or the State Department, when the Secretary of State or Defense travels and take reporters with them, you can walk around those buildings.
sentences.zh: 甚至在五角大楼或国务院，当国务卿或国防部长出行并带上记者时，你可以在那些大楼里四处走动。

sentences.en: Reporters and outsiders have real access.
sentences.zh: 记者和局外人拥有真正的接触权限。

sentences.en: At the CIA, we could spend weeks trying to find out the name of, like, the chief of staff for Ms. Haspel.
sentences.zh: 但在中情局，我们要花上好几个星期才能查到诸如哈斯佩尔女士幕僚长的名字。

sentences.en: I mean, there is just no access.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，根本没有接触渠道。

sentences.en: The closest I can get on any day is driving by.
sentences.zh: 我在任何一天能做到的最近距离就是开车从旁经过。

sentences.en: And the main road outside of it, there's the big signs saying no pictures.
sentences.zh: 在它外面的主路上，有写着“禁止拍照”的大招牌。

sentences.en: And there's, like, a checkpoint half a mile that you can't see.
sentences.zh: 半英里外还有一个你看不到的检查站。

sentences.en: This is a large, well-financed agency that does at times use violence.
sentences.zh: 这是一个庞大、资金充足、有时会使用暴力的机构。

sentences.en: And it's only real oversight or two committees in Congress.
sentences.zh: 它仅有的真正监督也就是国会的两个委员会。

sentences.en: And so this rare public moment, they want to hear as much as they can and pin her down as much as they can.
sentences.zh: 所以在这样一个罕见的公开时刻，他们想要尽可能多地听取信息，并尽可能把她钉死。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And at the FBI, Comey didn't intend for us to know what he had done vis-a-vis President Trump until he was fired.
sentences.zh: 而在FBI，科米直到被解雇之前，并没有打算让我们知道他针对特朗普总统做过什么。

sentences.en: So in many ways, the senators at this hearing are saying, given that we may never know whether the president asks you to do something like this,
sentences.zh: 所以在许多方面，这场听证会上的参议员们是在说：鉴于我们可能永远不会知道总统是否要求你做过类似的事情，

sentences.en: we really need to ask you now and we really need to understand your moral code.
sentences.zh: 我们现在真的需要问你，并且我们真的需要理解你的道德准则。

sentences.en: And we need to ask you to tell us, too, that if it does happen, come and tell us.
sentences.zh: 我们也需要你告诉我们，如果真的发生了，来告诉我们。

sentences.en: Did Democrats seem satisfied by the answers that Haspel gave about how she would handle requests from President Trump?
sentences.zh: 民主党人似乎对哈斯佩尔关于她将如何处理来自特朗普总统的要求所给出的回答感到满意吗？

sentences.en: Because it's really that question that seems to be keeping them from supporting her.
sentences.zh: 因为正是这个问题似乎在阻碍他们支持她。

sentences.en: You know, I'm not sure.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我不太确定。

sentences.en: But I think, you know, the math was already in her favor that Republicans control the Senate.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，你知道的，胜算已经对她有利，因为共和党人控制了参议院。

sentences.en: Rand Paul and John McCain had signaled they weren't going to vote for her, but Susan Collins seemed to be leaning that direction.
sentences.zh: 兰德·保罗和约翰·麦凯恩已经暗示他们不会投票给她，但苏珊·柯林斯似乎倾向于那个方向。

sentences.en: And there were Democrats who clearly wanted to vote for her.
sentences.zh: 而且有一些民主党人显然想投票给她。

sentences.en: And we're just looking for her to say some things.
sentences.zh: 我们只是在等她说出某些话。

sentences.en: Senator, my father's watching today.
sentences.zh: 参议员，我父亲今天在看直播。

sentences.en: He served 33 years in the Air Force.
sentences.zh: 他在空军服役了33年。

sentences.en: My parents gave me a very strong moral compass.
sentences.zh: 我的父母赋予了我非常坚定的道德指南针。

sentences.en: I support the higher moral standard that this country has decided to hold itself to.
sentences.zh: 我支持这个国家决定遵循的更高道德标准。

sentences.en: I would never, ever take CIA back to an interrogation program.
sentences.zh: 我绝不会、绝不会把中情局带回审讯项目。

sentences.en: First of all, CIA follows the law.
sentences.zh: 首先，中情局遵守法律。

sentences.en: We followed the law then.
sentences.zh: 我们当时遵守法律。

sentences.en: We follow the law today.
sentences.zh: 我们今天也遵守法律。

sentences.en: I support the law.
sentences.zh: 我支持法律。

sentences.en: I wouldn't support a change in the law.
sentences.zh: 我不会支持修改法律。

sentences.en: But I'll tell you this.
sentences.zh: 但我会告诉你这一点。

sentences.en: I would not put CIA officers at risk by asking them to undertake risky, controversial activity again.
sentences.zh: 我不会通过要求中情局官员再次开展冒险、有争议的活动来将他们置于危险之中。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》App？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《纽约时报》才能阅读所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但是，如果你能免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》App时，你在该App中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间突破付费墙，去看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》App并获得30天的免费访问权限吧。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Wednesday, North Korea released three American prisoners, removing a major diplomatic obstacle to a nuclear deal,
sentences.zh: 周三，朝鲜释放了三名美国囚犯，为达成核协议扫清了一个重大的外交障碍，

sentences.en: ahead of a planned meeting between President Trump and Kim Jong-un.
sentences.zh: 在此之前，特朗普总统和金正恩计划举行会晤。

sentences.en: The Americans, who were held for at least a year on charges of spying and hostile acts, were released to Secretary of State Mike Pompeo during a 13-hour visit to North Korea.
sentences.zh: 这些美国人因间谍和敌对行为罪名被关押了至少一年，在国务卿迈克·蓬佩奥对朝鲜进行为期13小时的访问期间被释放移交给了他。

sentences.en: The Times reports that freeing the prisoners is Kim's most tangible gesture yet to improve relations with the U.S.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》报道称，释放这些囚犯是金正恩迄今为止为改善与美国关系所做出的最实质性姿态。

sentences.en: And it signals a willingness to compromise in the upcoming talks.
sentences.zh: 这标志着他在即将到来的会谈中表现出妥协的意愿。

sentences.en: The prisoners are scheduled to arrive in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这些囚犯预计将于

sentences.en: on Thursday morning, where they will be greeted by President Trump at Andrews Air Force Base.
sentences.zh: 周四上午抵达美国，特朗普总统将在安德鲁斯空军基地迎接他们。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》中，我们正为假期招待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人们宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是全黑才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they black out to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们喝断片儿才睡着。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症吗，对食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 请在《纽约时报》应用程序或您习惯收听播客的任何地方搜索《Wirecutter秀》。
